summary: Build credit portfolio analytics and early warning indicators skills with dashboards, trigger design, and reporting templates. Enrol now.
lede: Credit portfolio analytics and early warning indicators help credit teams identify deterioration and structure monitoring. For credit analysts, portfolio managers, risk officers and others working with credit data, the course develops skills in migration and delinquency analysis, indicator and trigger design, and dashboard reporting for watchlist and escalation decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with credit data, borrower reviews, or portfolio oversight and need to strengthen portfolio monitoring practice with early warning indicators and reporting discipline.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, Microsoft Excel, and the ability to review sample portfolio extracts and reporting templates. Familiarity with credit terms, borrower reviews, and portfolio monitoring reports will help you participate effectively in the exercises.
